The '''bathalz'''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Th'irus]]&mdash;a planet which had only reptilian and insectoid lifeforms. The bathalz' closely resembled the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] and was domesticated by the [[Th'iruckai]].
